title: mutastic rules file, v1
description: A rules file: call operators as data, a plugin listed under `plugins:` in `mutastic.yaml`. Each list item is one operator. mutastic reads each value as text, a list as text separated by commas, and a field it doesn't know as an error. See https://docs.mutastic.io/guides/plugins/#rules-files.

list.description: A list, separated by commas, on one line.

^(headline|help)\\.[^.]+$.description: `headline` or `help` for one of the methods: `headline.sorted`, used for that method instead.

id.description: `namespace/name`, lower case: how reports, `--operators` and ignores name it.

explanation.description: What it changes, and when a test misses that: shown by `mutastic explain`.

tier.description: The set it's in: `defaults` (unless it says), `stronger` or `extended`.

owners.description: The types whose calls it matches, in full: `java.lang.String`.

descriptors.description: The overloads it matches, as the JVM writes them: `(Ljava/lang/String;)Z`. Every overload if it's left out.

since.description: The Java release the rewrite needs: `11`. In a class file for an older one, its mutants are skipped as unviable.

rewrite.description: What the call becomes: `remove`, `rename a->b, c->d`, `omit last argument`, `unchecked arithmetic`, `keep argument`, or `call name(ARGS) with A, B`.

source.description: How a `call` rewrite reads in the source, for its label: `first(Long.MAX_VALUE)`.

changed.description: What the line now does, in a code frame: `stage removed`. `{to}` is what a rename calls instead.

headline.description: A missed mutant's headline, the gap in the tests. `{name}` is the method called, `{to}` what a rename calls instead, and `{method}` the method the call is in.

help.description: The test to write, with the same placeholders as `headline`.
